text: {"final": {"findings": [{"id": "R1", "statement": "Eligibility rule: a household is eligible when its status is 'active' AND its vulnerability_score >= QUALIFYING_SCORE (50). Signature: is_eligible(household: Household, score: int | None = None, today=None) -> bool in eligibility/rules.py; use vulnerability_score(household, today) from eligibility/scoring.py if no score is passed.", "file": "eligibility/rules.py"}, {"id": "R2", "statement": "Eligible households are enrolled in the 'cash' program: programs() returns ['food', 'cash'] for every eligible household (plus 'shelter' if shelter_damaged), so cash applies to all eligible households.", "file": "eligibility/rules.py"}, {"id": "R3", "statement": "Payment sending: disburse(household_id: str, amount: int, key: str, *, now=None) -> Payment in payments/vouchers.py appends to data/outbox/payments.jsonl (IRREVERSIBLE). It requires feature('cash_enabled') (True in config/settings.py FEATURES), amount a positive int, household status 'active', and raises DuplicatePayment if the key was already used. The idempotency key format is payment_key(household_id, cycle) = f\"{household_id}:{cycle}\" — for cycle 2 use key '{household_id}:2'.", "file": "payments/vouchers.py"}, {"id": "R4", "statement": "sent_payments() -> list[Payment] reads the payments outbox; a script can check which households already have a payment with key '{id}:2' before/instead of calling disburse, guaranteeing exactly-once payment per household per cycle.", "file": "payments/vouchers.py"}, {"id": "R5", "statement": "Households come from registry/load_households(*, active_only: bool = False) -> list[Household] reading data/registry.json; get_household(household_id) raises KeyError for unknown IDs. Only active households can be eligible.", "file": "registry/register.py"}, {"id": "R6", "statement": "Notification rule: after payment, SMS uses queue_sms(household_id, template_id, params, *, now=None) in notifications/sms.py with the approved template 'PAYMENT_SENT' = 'Lifeline: {amount} dollars sent for cycle {cycle}. Ref {ref}.' (params: amount, cycle, ref). It raises ValueError if household.sms_ok is False and RuntimeError if feature('sms_enabled') is False (it is True). Filled text must be <= 140 chars (MAX_LENGTH).", "file": "notifications/sms.py"}, {"id": "R7", "statement": "Script conventions: ops scripts live in scripts/, run from the Lifeline root, and must add the repo root to sys.path (sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent)) as in scripts/stock_report.py). Scripts that send payments or SMS, or change data/registry.json or data/ledger.json, must say so in their docstring.", "file": "scripts/stock_report.py"}, {"id": "R8", "statement": "The operation clock is fixed: config.settings.now() returns 2026-03-10T08:00:00 (override via LIFELINE_NOW env var); disburse and queue_sms default sent_at/queued_at to this. Payment IDs are generated with format_payment_id(next_number([p.id for p in sent_payments()], 'PAY-')) from core/ids.py.", "file": "config/settings.py"}, {"id": "R9", "statement": "Record-keeping helpers exist in payments/receipts.py: receipt_text(payment), receipts_for(household_id), and total_paid(household_id: str | None = None) -> int, all reading sent_payments() from the outbox — usable to verify the run paid each eligible household exactly once.", "file": "payments/receipts.py"}, {"id": "R10", "statement": "Data layout: data/ contains registry.json, ledger.json, network.json, audit.jsonl, sms_status.json and outbox/ (payments.jsonl and sms.jsonl live in data/outbox/). store.append_jsonl(OUTBOX, dict) from core/store.py is the append mechanism used by disburse and queue_sms.", "file": "config/settings.py"}]}}
